summary: Improve rolling forecasts, variance analysis and liquidity action planning. Explore this five-day treasury and finance course.
lede: Cash flow and liquidity management turns balances, receipts and payments into usable funding decisions. Designed for treasury analysts, cash managers and finance managers, the course develops rolling forecasts, forecast-variance analysis and working-capital assessment. You will also assess funding gaps and surplus cash, build liquidity scenarios and consider IAS 7 and IFRS 7 reporting context.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is designed for professionals who prepare, review or act on cash forecasts and liquidity information. It suits practitioners who need to connect finance and operating inputs with funding, investment and working-capital decisions.
modules: Daily Cash Position and Liquidity Visibility
Actual Cash Flows and Variance Analysis
Funding Gaps and Surplus Cash Actions
prerequisites: Prior practical exposure to treasury, finance or cash-flow reporting is recommended. You should be comfortable working with spreadsheet tables and basic financial information. Coding is not required; advanced accounting-policy interpretation is outside the course scope.
